relation_statement: The residual (identity) path must carry the original block input, not the normalized tensor, under a pre-LN sequential block.
observable_signal: activation checksum of the residual addend vs block input; loss value spike
evidence_from_issue: attn_norm overwrites residual stream
evidence_from_fix: x = self.attn_norm(x) clobbering residual stream so identity path uses normed x

relation_statement: A parameter's reduced gradient must be equal across all DP ranks after reduce_scatter under ZeRO-1/2.
observable_signal: per-parameter gradient checksum/norm compared across DP ranks
evidence_from_issue: Cross-partition parameters incorrectly updated ... reduce_scatter=true and Muon optimizer
evidence_from_fix: reduce_scatter 后非 target rank 保留了未 reduce 的 local 梯度，跨 partition 边界的参数梯度在不同 rank 间不一致

relation_statement: DistributedAttention output must equal the single-rank reference regardless of whether sequence length is divisible by world size.
observable_signal: output tensor max abs diff vs reference implementation
validity_precondition: sequence length not divisible by world_size
evidence_from_issue: produces numerically incorrect results when sequence length is not divisible by world size
evidence_from_fix: SeqAllToAll ... 错误的 uneven split，输出与参考实现有 max abs diff ~0.68 的偏差

relation_statement: bias_correction2 must be identical across all subgroup invocations of the same optimizer step regardless of computation path.
observable_signal: bias_correction2 scalar value across subgroup calls within one step
validity_precondition: ZeRO-3 with CPU-offloaded CPUAdam and multiple subgroups
evidence_from_issue: inconsistency metadata between subgroup
evidence_from_fix: std::pow 路径与乘法路径产生不同的 bias_correction2 值，导致参数更新不一致

relation_statement: The tensor size metadata must faithfully represent the true element count (no int32 overflow) so the update kernel executes.
observable_signal: sizes-array value vs actual numel; parameter delta after step
evidence_from_issue: Integer overflow in FusedAdam silently prevents weight updates for large tensors
evidence_from_fix: sizes 数组使用 int32，超过 2^31 个元素的 tensor 溢出为负值，CUDA kernel 循环不执行

relation_statement: The fp16 loss scale must be finite (bounded, not inf/nan) before it scales gradients.
observable_signal: loss_scale scalar finiteness; gradient NaN count
evidence_from_issue: Missing input validation for fp16 loss_scale accepts float('inf')
evidence_from_fix: loss_scale 接受 float('inf') ... 梯度被 inf 缩放后悄悄变成 NaN

relation_statement: Recomputed activations under activation checkpointing must be identical to the original forward pass, so dropout masks match.
observable_signal: activation/dropout-mask checksum: original forward vs recompute
evidence_from_issue: accuracy issue for torch.compile if activation checkpoint function not compiler disabled
evidence_from_fix: RNG state 保存/恢复机制不匹配导致 dropout 在 forward/backward 间产生不同随机数

relation_statement: Each MoE expert's identity/placement mapping must be preserved and not overwritten by ZeRO-3 hook registration.
observable_signal: expert id attribute value; expert-to-GPU mapping table
evidence_from_issue: Overwrites Module ID Attribute Causing Incorrect Expert Placement on GPUs
evidence_from_fix: _register_hooks_recursively 使用通用 .id 属性覆盖用户自定义的 expert ID

relation_statement: After gradient all-reduce, weights/gradients must be equal across DP ranks, including the last micro-batch's contribution.
observable_signal: gradient/weight checksum across DP ranks
evidence_from_issue: last-microbatch grad leak under ZeRO-1
evidence_from_fix: allreduce_gradients() called before backward_epilogue; last micro-batch grads not included in allreduce

relation_statement: The CPU-offloaded accumulated gradient must equal the sum of all micro-step gradients, not just the first.
observable_signal: accumulator checksum / gradient norm across micro-steps
validity_precondition: ZeRO-1/2 with CPU offload and gradient accumulation
evidence_from_issue: CPU-offloaded gradient norm frozen after first microstep
evidence_from_fix: micro_step_id > 0 的梯度被丢弃而非累积到 CPU，梯度范数在首个 microstep 后冻结

relation_statement: The loss-scale applied at backward must be consistently unscaled from gradients, and gradients must be reset each step.
observable_signal: gradient norm value; loss_scale factor
evidence_from_issue: bf16 gradient norm divergence with ZeRO stage 0
evidence_from_fix: loss scale=65536 但 backward 时未缩放 loss，梯度被除以 65536；非 ZeRO bf16 梯度清零被跳过

relation_statement: The overflow-guarded early return must trigger only when overflow is actually detected, so the step applies updates otherwise.
observable_signal: overflow flag value vs whether optimizer step applied; parameter delta
evidence_from_issue: Misplaced overflow return always exits FP16 optimizer step
evidence_from_fix: return self.overflow at wrong indentation causes optimizer step to always return early

relation_statement: The recorded gradient norm must reflect the actual clipped gradients after CPU-offload gradient clipping.
observable_signal: recorded grad norm value vs recomputed norm of clipped grads
evidence_from_issue: Update grad norm calculation for CPU offload
evidence_from_fix: norm_for_param_grads 数据结构未更新，记录的梯度范数与实际 clipped 梯度不一致

relation_statement: On non-boundary micro-steps gradients must accumulate (sum) rather than overwrite, under Z2+offload.
observable_signal: gradient accumulator checksum across micro-steps
validity_precondition: ZeRO-2 with offload and gradient accumulation
evidence_from_issue: Fix gradient accumulation for Z2+offload
evidence_from_fix: micro_step_id 初始化不一致（构造函数 0 vs backward -1），非累积边界时也执行梯度复制而非累积

relation_statement: The reduce-scatter must be ordered after the gradient write completes on the autograd stream under ZeRO-3.
observable_signal: NaN occurrence in reduced gradients (race witness)
validity_precondition: ZeRO-3 with non-default backward CUDA stream
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3 uses default_stream instead of current_stream for gradient reduce
evidence_from_fix: wait_stream uses default_stream() instead of current_stream(); reduce-scatter starts before grad write completes, random NaN

relation_statement: Checkpoint shard files must be merged in numeric index order, not lexicographic order.
observable_signal: shard file ordering (9,10,11 vs 10,11,9); merged state checksum
evidence_from_issue: Fix sort of zero checkpoint files
evidence_from_fix: 按字母顺序排序分片文件（10, 11, 9 而非 9, 10, 11），optimizer state 碎片合并顺序错误

relation_statement: bias-correction metadata must be bit-identical across multiple subgroup calls of the same logical optimizer step.
observable_signal: bias-correction metadata value across subgroup invocations
validity_precondition: CPUAdam IncrementStep with multiple subgroups per step
evidence_from_issue: Fix Adam subgroup inconsistency
evidence_from_fix: 多次 subgroup 调用中混合了乘法和重计算路径，产生非 bit-identical 的 bias-correction metadata

relation_statement: The secondary tensor must be refreshed to match the primary parameter after GatheredParameters exit and after checkpoint load.
observable_signal: secondary-tensor checksum vs primary; first-step loss magnitude
evidence_from_issue: ds_secondary_tensor may be dirty when loading the model or zero checkpoint for zero++
evidence_from_fix: 退出后和 checkpoint 加载后 ds_secondary_tensor 未同步更新，后续 allgather 使用了过时的缓存数据

relation_statement: MoE parameter gradients must be scaled exactly once, not double-divided by the MoE bucket flag.
observable_signal: MoE gradient magnitude vs expected single-scaled value
validity_precondition: MoE params in a bucket with ipg_bucket_has_moe_params set
evidence_from_issue: MoE gradient scaling divides by ipg_bucket_has_moe_params when it shouldn't
evidence_from_fix: divide=self.ipg_bucket_has_moe_params incorrectly divides MoE grads by bucket count

relation_statement: Residual-MoE softmax must normalize expert/MLP coefficients to sum to one over the last dimension.
observable_signal: sum of expert coefficients over the intended dimension (should equal 1)
evidence_from_issue: Residual MoE softmax applied on wrong dimension
evidence_from_fix: softmax(coef, dim=1) should be dim=-1 for correct expert coefficient normalization

relation_statement: The all-reduce must operate on the FP32 gradient buffer, not the BF16 gradients, under BF16_Optimizer with ZeRO-0.
observable_signal: dtype tag of the tensor passed to all-reduce; reduced gradient precision
validity_precondition: BF16_Optimizer accumulating in an FP32 buffer
evidence_from_issue: Fix allreduce for BF16 and ZeRO0
evidence_from_fix: engine 对 BF16 梯度执行 allreduce 而非 FP32 buffer，导致 reduce 的精度错误

relation_statement: The MoE gate parameter's gradient must be captured by the ZeRO hook and reduced across DP ranks.
observable_signal: gate gradient presence/checksum across ranks; gate weight divergence
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO Stage 2 seems to train MoE models incorrectly
evidence_from_fix: MoE gate 参数未被 ZeRO-2 的梯度 hook 捕获，gate 梯度从不参与 reduce

relation_statement: Sequence-parallel gradients must be summed across SP ranks then averaged within the DP group, not divided by global world size, and reduced in FP32.
observable_signal: gradient scaling factor / gradient norm growth over steps
evidence_from_issue: Fix the sequence-parallelism for the dense model architecture
evidence_from_fix: 梯度被全局 world_size 错误缩放（应 SP rank 求和后 DP group 取平均），SP reduce 在 BF16 下执行精度损失

relation_statement: The gradient norm must be all-reduced across DP ranks so results are identical across ZeRO stages 0/1/2/3.
observable_signal: gradient norm value across DP ranks and across ZeRO stages
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3: Gradient norm allreduce for DP
evidence_from_fix: gradient norm 在 DP 训练中未正确 allreduce，导致 ZeRO 0/1/2/3 产生不同的训练结果

relation_statement: The optimizer step must cast gradients to FP32 when grad_accum dtype differs from model dtype under bf16.
observable_signal: dtype tag of gradient entering optimizer step; update accuracy
validity_precondition: bf16 optimizer with grad_accum dtype != model dtype
evidence_from_issue: bf16_optimizer: fixes to different grad acc dtype
evidence_from_fix: step 函数在 gradient accumulation dtype 与 model dtype 不同时未正确转换梯度到 FP32

relation_statement: The top-2 MoE aux-loss must use the correct coefficient (not an extra factor of num_experts), and the gate parameter must not be re-cast off the ZeRO flat buffer.
observable_signal: aux-loss magnitude vs expected; gate parameter dtype/identity
validity_precondition: MoE gate with TP alignment and ZeRO flat-buffer params
evidence_from_issue: MOE gate fixes and enhancements
evidence_from_fix: top-2 aux loss 公式多乘了 num_experts；gate 线性层在 forward 中被转成 fp32 破坏参数管理

relation_statement: The gradient clipping scale factor must stay finite; NaN/inf handling must not convert a finite scale into NaN.
observable_signal: clip scale factor finiteness; gradient NaN count after clipping
validity_precondition: gradient clipping with NaN/inf grad-norm handling
evidence_from_issue: Grad norm NaN handling uses wrong tensor operation (logical_or)
evidence_from_fix: inf * logical_not 运算将 inf 转为 NaN，NaN 传播到 gradient clipping 的缩放因子

relation_statement: Training convergence must be invariant to reduce_bucket_size, which should affect only communication efficiency.
observable_signal: loss curve / final loss across different bucket sizes
evidence_from_issue: reduce_bucket_size influences training convergence of Zero2
evidence_from_fix: 不同 bucket size 导致显著不同的 loss 曲线，极小值会导致 NaN

relation_statement: Per-rank gradient contributions must be weighted proportionally to actual sample counts when a minibatch does not fill dp_size*micro_batch_size.
observable_signal: per-rank microbatch sample count vs gradient weighting
validity_precondition: drop_last=False with incomplete minibatch at DP boundary
evidence_from_issue: Zero-sized microbatches for incomplete minibatches at DP boundary
evidence_from_fix: get_start_end_idx doesn't account for batch_len < dp_size * micro_batch_size; 梯度在不同 microbatch 大小间错误平均

relation_statement: The checkpoint directory label must match the internal global_step recorded in the checkpoint.
observable_signal: checkpoint directory step number vs internal global_step value
evidence_from_issue: Checkpoint global_step number inconsistent with checkpoint step number
evidence_from_fix: checkpoint-800 包含 global_step799，差距随训练扩大

relation_statement: Parameters in a coalesced all-gather must keep a consistent dtype and unique identity so parameter-state tracking stays valid under autocast.
observable_signal: parameter dtype tag; param availability state (AVAILABLE vs inflight)
validity_precondition: ZeRO-3 coalesced all-gather under PyTorch autocast
evidence_from_issue: Fix all-gather duplicate params and wrong dtype
evidence_from_fix: autocast 下同一 coalesced all-gather 中多个操作共享含混合 dtype 参数的列表，参数状态追踪错乱

relation_statement: All MiCS partition groups' state must be saved and restored, not just the first partition group.
observable_signal: presence/checksum of each partition group's checkpoint data on save and load
evidence_from_issue: Fix saving and loading model checkpoint logic for MiCS sharding
evidence_from_fix: MiCS 只有第一个 partition group 保存 checkpoint，其他 group 的数据丢失
